//: Live configuration for the character art tool.
Edit and save — the running app picks it up on the next request, with no
restart. Reload the overlay to see it.
sources — which sites to search, merged into one grid and de-duplicated
by file hash so the same picture posted to several boorus appears once:
danbooru  four rating tiers, the biggest catalogue, best tag data
yandere   high-quality scans; three tiers where 'safe' maps to General,
and nothing maps to Sensitive, so a Sensitive-only view shows
nothing from it. No artist attribution: moebooru does not say
which of a post's tags is the artist.
An empty or unrecognised list falls back to danbooru alone.
enabled — which rating tiers to serve, in Danbooru's vocabulary:
g  General       no nudity, nothing suggestive
s  Sensitive     swimsuits, underwear, revealing outfits - not pornographic
q  Questionable  partial nudity, strong suggestion, no explicit acts
e  Explicit      pornographic
These are exact buckets, not levels: ["s"] serves ONLY sensitive and
excludes general. To widen, add a letter rather than swapping it.
blockedTags — extra tags to drop on sight, added to the built-in list in
art.mjs. This ADDS to that list and cannot remove from it; the built-in
entries are the ones keeping this away from sexualised art of characters
who are minors, so taking one out is a deliberate code edit. Names are
normalised, so "Cow Print" and cow_print are the same thing.
If this file is missing, unparseable, or lists nothing valid, the app keeps
the last good value and falls back to ["g"] with the built-in denylist on
a cold start - it never fails open to something more permissive.
